description_en: Lists the migration tasks created by a user in the specific region
description_zh: 列举用户在该区域下的迁移任务
kebab_example: aliyun hcs-mgw list-job --marker test_marker --count 1000 --parent-name test_parent_job_name --all true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListJob

parameters.description_en:
The marker after which the migration tasks are listed.\
By default, this parameter is left empty.
parameters.description_zh:
设定从该marker之后列举迁移任务。  
默认值：无
